summary: Preserved candidate PR 1959's verified DSpark context/generation-boundary fix and corrected the independently reproduced registered-test taxonomy failure by moving its regression from test/registered/spec/dspark to test/registered/unit/dspark.

tests.what_was_measured: Failing-before evidence: the exact candidate regression used invalid registered-test kind directory `spec`.
At the exact candidate commit, all four focused position-boundary tests passed; no runtime counterexample was found.
Passing-after evidence: the corrected unit test path satisfies registered-test taxonomy.
39 tests and 18 subtests passed across the corrected boundary regression and existing DSpark scheduler/ragged coverage.
Both changed runtime modules compile as Python source.

gpu_execution_evidence: The preserved candidate evidence and independent review exercised boundary tensor arithmetic on the assigned AMD Instinct MI355X; this correction itself changes only test placement.
remaining_limitations: DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731 weights were unavailable, so full-model semantic behavior was not exercised.
The reported two-GPU NVIDIA B300 CUDA 13 environment was unavailable; the prepared environment exposed one AMD GPU on ROCm 7.2.
The original fused_q_norm_rope CUDA illegal-address crash and TP2 behavior were not reproduced directly.
No native rebuild was applicable because the candidate and correction change no native source.
